text.title: Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Countenance / Account
text.italic: Argued from · evidence registers: descent, attested sense, operational homology, poetic re-entry kept distinct

text.body: The priority is operative, not a claim that people first met without language and only later invented it. An inherited name can make the meeting possible. Its use nevertheless takes place within a relation which can exceed and revise that use. Taylor's encounter synthesis grounds the whole-field proposition: the with-relation is prior to treating its opposed terms as independently complete.

text.title: Whole Field — Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis
text.italic: field E2 · Argued authorial relational construction; source-specific semantic, historical and comparative branches distinguished. · evidence registers: descent, attested sense, operational homology, poetic re-entry kept distinct

text.body: The field does not claim that *arbitration*, *hybris*, *regard* and *anamnesis* descend from one root. Historical derivation and attested senses belong to registers 1 Philological descent and 2 Attested semantic field and must be warranted term by term in the historical/source branch. The conjugate generation below is register 3 Operational homology / authorial relational construction.

text.title: Whole Field — Fides / Topos / Logos / Nomos / Natio / Credere
text.italic: Paraphrased lexical and historical witnesses; Argued authorial relational construction; explicitly marked poetic re-entry · evidence registers: descent, attested sense, operational homology, poetic re-entry kept distinct

text.body: Lewis and Short's *fides* entry sources reliance on a person or thing and the credibility granted to testimony. Its Ciceronian examples connect confidence to judgment of competence and justice. These are lexical witnesses in register 2, not a Roman derivation of the essay's formal limit.

scenes.name: Whole Field — Symbol / Account / Trust
scenes.character: A whole-field: six operations generated around one centre, returns kept open.

text.title: Whole Field — Symbol / Account / Trust
text.italic: evidence registers: descent, attested sense, operational homology, poetic re-entry kept distinct

text.body: A Symbol is a determinate form that discloses a relation beyond what the form exhausts. An Account is the articulated reckoning or report by which that disclosure becomes answerable and transmissible. Trust is the committed reliance by which an account can guide action without becoming possession of its source.

scenes.name: Whole Field — Homologia / Analogia
scenes.character: A whole-field: six operations generated around one centre, returns kept open.

text.title: Whole Field — Homologia / Analogia
text.italic: Argued from the native Taylor field; historical relations separately scoped in the companion · evidence registers: descent, attested sense, operational homology, poetic re-entry kept distinct

text.body: The essay moves among mathematics, Śaiva metaphysics, Jungian psychology, language, topology, music and technical computation. Without a disciplined relational vocabulary, similarity quickly becomes false identity. Homologia / Analogia provides the grammar by which forms can answer to one another while remaining source-distinct.

scenes.name: Whole Field — Apportionment / Economy
scenes.character: A whole-field: six operations generated around one centre, returns kept open.

text.title: Whole Field — Apportionment / Economy
text.italic: Argued from native relational field; Paraphrased historical branches; operational homology distinguished from descent · evidence registers: descent, attested sense, operational homology, poetic re-entry kept distinct

text.body: Apportionment names the act of distributing a finite share, capacity, role or measure within a wider field. Economy names the ordering/management of a relational whole through which such distributions become operative. The canonical relation is not that these words share one root or one political theory. It is that finite agency repeatedly appears as a distribution of powers inside an order that no single share exhausts.
